summary: Current SLICE-002 implementation conforms to the approved PRD, SPEC r9, and Plan r3 boundaries. Canonical definition identity and validation, allowlisted asset loading with data-only validation/preload/cache and bounded retry, off-tree destroy/pool candidate creation, existing generation-lease and use-token cleanup, generation-safe handles, input blocking, protected synchronous hooks, and absolute-deadline quarantine behavior are already present. No real current-authority defect was observed, so no product or documentation files were changed; the remaining local-fixture and release-evidence work belongs to SLICE-004.
